paite: Huan gamsung ah kial anak kiak mahmah lai hi.
english: The famine was severe in the land.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a kipan a buh apuaktouh uh anekgaih nung un, apa un, akiang uah, "Kuan nawn unla buh tawmchik bek ei a ding in va lei nawn un," achi hi.
english: It happened, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”

paite: Huchi in Judah in akiang ah, "Huai mi'n, na naupa uh na hon tonpih kei uleh, ka mel na mu kei ding uh, chi in hon kalh giugeu hi.
english: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’

paite: Ka naupa uh na hon zuihsak dingleh, buh ka hon va leisak ding uh.
english: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food,

paite: N'on zuihsak nop kei dingleh zaw, ka hoh dah mai ding uh. Huai mi'n ka kiang uah, na nau uh na hon tonpih kei uleh, ka mel na mu kei ding uh, achita ngal a," chi in agen hi.
english: but if you’ll not send him, we’ll not go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”

paite: Israel in, "Bangziak in ahia nau dang na neih lai tantan na hilh chitchiat uh? Kei a dia hoih lou na hih uh?" achi hi.
english: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”

paite: Amau, "Huai mi'n, na pa uh dam lai hia? Unau dang na nei lai uhia? chi in i tanchin leh i tanaute tanchin ahon dong hi. Ahon thudot bang zel in ka hilh uhi. Na nau uh hon pisuk un, achi ding chih kua'n athei chitchiat dia?" achi uhi.
english: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down?’”

paite: Judah in apa Israel kiang ah, "Ka naupa uh hon zuisak in. Huchi in ka kisa ding ua, ka kuan ding uh. Kou leh nang leh ka taneu chikchikte uh leng si lou a i hintheihna ding un.
english: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.

paite: Atungtang thu keimah in bultum na ning. Ka khut a kipan mahmah ah amah hon phut in. Amah na kiang a ka hon pikik nawn louh a, na ma a ka hon dinsak nawn keileh, tangtawn in amoh ka po ding hi.
english: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever,

paite: Om sawt lou hi le ung, anihveina hong tung nawn khinta ding hi ung a,” achi hi.
english: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”

paite: Apa uh Israel in akiang uah, "Huchibang ahih vanglakleh hichi in hih un. Na seng un hiai gam a thil hoih khenkhat singnai damdawi, khuaizu, gimnamtui, murrah, theihawk leh makha gah, neukha chiat bek huai mi a ding thilpiak tawisuk un.
english: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this. Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

paite: Dangka amun nih in tawi unla, na ipgong bul ua ahon dangka piak nawn leng tawi nawn un; amuhkhelh ahi kha ding.
english: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

paite: Na naupa uh leng pi un, thou unla, huai mi kiang ah va hoh nawn un.
english: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.

paite: Na sanggampa uh khat pen leh Benjamin ahon khahsakna ding in Pathian Bangkim hihthei in huai mi hon zahngaisak hen. Ka tate suun ka hihleh suun ka hita mai kei dia," achi hi.
english: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

paite: Huchi in thilpiak atawi ua, dangka leng amun nih atawi ua, Benjamin leng api uhi. Athou ua, Aigupta gam ah ahohsuk ua, Joseph ma ah adingh nawn uhi.
english: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

paite: Joseph in akiang ua Benjamin om amuhtak in, a-inkemmi kiang ah, "Huai mite insung ah pilut inla, gan gou inla, bawl in, huai mite'n sun chiang in ka kiang ah an ane ding uh," achi hi.
english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n Joseph thupiak bang in ahihta a; Joseph inn ah apilutta hi.
english: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

paite: Joseph inn a pilut a a-om ziak un alau ua, "I hoh masak lai a, i ip ua dangka hong kik nawnte ziak in ei ve ahon pilut uh. I tung ua siatna zong a, hon sual in, ei leh i sabiltungte toh sikha ding a mat hon tum ahita ve," achi uhi.
english: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

paite: Joseph inkemmi kiang ah ava hoh ua, kongbul ah ahoupih uhi.
english: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

paite: "Ka toupa aw, ka hong masak lai ua buh lei ding lel a hong suk ka hi uh.
english: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, giahbuk ka tun un ka ipte uh ka hong ua, ngai in, ka dangka chiat uh ka ipgong bul uah ana om hi. Ka dangka uh abuk ngeingei in ana om a, huchi in ka hon tawi uhi.
english: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

paite: Buh leina ding in dangka dang ka hon tawi ua, ka dangka uh lah kua'n ahia ka ip ua koih ka thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi.
english: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”

paite: Ama'n, "Lungmuangtak in om unla, lau kei un. Na Pathian, na pa uh Pathian in na ipte uah gou ahon pia ahi mai ve. Na dangka uh lah ka mu ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in akiang uah Simeon hon pikhia hi.
english: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.

paite: Huai mi in Joseph insung ah amaute apilut a, tui apia hi. Akhe uh asil ua; asabiltungte uh leng an apia hi.
english: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.

paite: Athilpiak tawi uh Joseph sun an ne ding a ahong pai ma in ana bawlkhol ua; huai ah an ane ding uh chih lah aza ngal ua.
english: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

paite: Joseph a-inn a ahong paitak in, akhut ua thilpiakte, insung ah akiang ah atawilut ua, lei si in amai ah akun chiat uhi.
english: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to him to the earth.

paite: Ama'n atanchin uh adong a, "Na pa uh tanchin na gen uh, huai putek ahoih na maw? Adam lai hia?" achi hi.
english: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”

paite: Amau, "Na sikha ka pa uh damtheihna ahoih in, adam laitak ahi," achi uh. Huchi in alu uh akunsak ua, zahtakna apia uhi.
english: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.

paite: Amah adak a, anau Benjamin, anu tapa amu a, "Hiai na nautumpen uh, atanchin na hon hilh uhia?" achi hi. Amah mah in, "Ka tapa, Pathian in hon hehpih hen," achi hi.
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”

paite: Joseph in anaupa amuh in akhase mahmah a, kintak in kahna ding mun azong pah a, adantan sung ah alut a, huai ah akapkheta hi.
english: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.

paite: Amai aphiat a, ava pawt nawn a, akidek teitei a, "An nek bawl un," achi hi.
english: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”

paite: Huchi in amah a ding atuam in, amaute a ding atuam in, Aigupta mi anekpihte a ding atuam in abawlta uhi. Aiguptate'n lah Hebrute anekpih thei ngal kei ua; huchibang hih lah Aiguptate a ding in thilsiang lou ahi.
english: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians, that ate with him, by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat bread with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

paite: Huchi in a-upapen ta masa ahihna bang in, anaupangpen nautumpen ahihna bang dungzui zel in Joseph ma ah atu ua; huchi in lamdang asa chiat uhi.
english: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled one with another.

paite: Joseph in ama a mite a kipan tantuan an aban piaksak a, Benjamin tantuan houh amaute tantuan tengteng sang in amun nga in atam tuam hi. Uain adawn ua, nuam asa chiat uhi.
english: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.
